blocking_condition: An untouched natural source family with complete semantic gold, legally retrievable missing evidence and a residual surviving all simple baselines has not been identified.

authorization.release_rule: No arm may execute unless a later authority freezes a qualifying panel and updates every zero authorization value.

arms.purpose: Candidate action selection beyond fixed closure

contingent_design.retry_policy: No silent retries; a transport failure is reported separately and does not consume a physical generation attempt unless generated tokens are returned.

fixed_input_and_tool_budgets.visible_source_boundary: Only table plus retrieved units returned by the arm's legal action are model-visible.
fixed_input_and_tool_budgets.oracle_prohibition: Gold paragraph IDs, gold programs, answer strings and evaluator-only evidence may never enter a deployable prompt or tool result.
fixed_input_and_tool_budgets.model_responsibility: Semantic fact selection and bounded action choice only

required_aggregate_metrics.full_semantic_answer_accuracy: Exact agreement with the frozen full semantic answer after legal tool execution.
required_aggregate_metrics.wrong_to_correct: Count and rate among examples wrong or undelivered in the matched ordinary-top3 control.
required_aggregate_metrics.correct_to_wrong: Count and rate among examples correct in the matched ordinary-top3 control.
required_aggregate_metrics.reasonable_unknown: Count and rate of outputs that abstain for a reference-validated missing-evidence condition.
required_aggregate_metrics.wrong_delivery: Count and rate of concrete answers not equal to the full semantic reference.
required_aggregate_metrics.correct_coverage: Count and rate of examples whose gold evidence is present in the arm-visible evidence set before generation.
required_aggregate_metrics.actual_cost: Physical attempts, prompt tokens, completion tokens, generated tokens, tool calls, wall-clock seconds and any measured monetary cost.

reporting_contract.confidence_interval_method: Paired bootstrap over physical examples; no test-time resampling of generations.
reporting_contract.minimum_success_line: The qualified adaptive arm must improve full semantic answer accuracy over ordinary top-3, fixed top-3-radius-1 and always-expand radius-5 controls at matched or lower total cost without increasing correct-to-wrong or wrong-delivery rates.
reporting_contract.failure_line: If fixed radius 5 or a stronger ordinary retrieval/fixed lookup control explains the residual, record NO_GO and do not proceed to training.

diagnostics: gold-evidence recall before and after each legal action
whether missing gold is textually present in the pinned source
whether top-k, radius-1, radius-2 or radius-5 recovers it
boilerplate versus computationally necessary gold decomposition

freeze_gate: Untouched natural source family is pinned by immutable path and SHA-256.
Full semantic reference independently executes to the accepted answer.
Missing evidence is legally retrievable and oracle evidence is separated.
Residual survives exact cache, metadata/period rules, ordinary retrieval, fixed larger k, fixed neighborhood closure and always-expand controls.
Every panel example is added to the future exposure union before generation.
Authority explicitly changes authorized attempts, tokens and arms from zero.
stop_conditions: Any simple baseline explains the residual.
A panel example lacks a complete semantic reference or deployable legal action.
Oracle evidence is visible to a deployable arm.
The planned 48-attempt or 240000-token ceiling would be exceeded.
Any model, judge, training or production side effect occurs outside this contract.
